thread:
Alex: Heads-up — proposing a staged canary for model-v13 starting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Plan: EU first 1% -> 5% over 3h, NA held at 0.5% (opt-in) until EU is green. Flag: `ff.model.v13.canary`. Any objections?
Priya: SGTM. We need telemetry gates: api.error_rate, token.latency_p99, and eval.regression_delta on our smoke prompt set. Can you list specific thresholds?
Jamal: I'd add automation: auto-cut if 5m `api.error_rate` > 1.0% OR `token.latency_p99` > 1.5s, with a manual override. Who wires that?
Leo: I can hook the rollout-service automation. Need exact metric names + slack webhook + escalation target.
Alex: Metric names above are fine. Add cost spike gate too: if cost_per_1k_tokens goes up > 20% vs baseline -> pause. Alerts to #eng-oncall and @oncall. Also attach rollout tag for audit.
Marisol: For EU canary, restrict audience to live user traffic (exclude internal/beta). Audience filter: `region=EU AND traffic_source!=internal`. Can we mirror traffic for 1h dry-run first?
Priya: Yes to mirror. Also we should run an eval regression after the first 1% window and compare classification prompts in `eval/smoke_v3`. If regression_delta > 0.02 -> rollback.
Jamal: @infra-bot please reserve burst capacity for canary window: gpu-pool-a x2 tomorrow 08:30-12:00 UTC.
infra-bot: infra-bot: reservation submitted. Reservation ID: `res-271234`. Status: pending approval from capacity owners.
Leo: Sample rollout payload I'll use for the service (placeholder):
```json
{
  "flag": "ff.model.v13.canary",
  "audiences": [
    {"region": "EU", "start_pct": 1.0, "target_pct": 5.0, "ramp_hours": 3},
    {"region": "NA", "start_pct": 0.5, "target_pct": 0.5, "ramp_hours": 0, "opt_in": true}
  ],
  "gates": {
    "auto_cut": {
      "error_rate_5m": 0.01,
      "latency_p99_s": 1.5,
      "cost_spike_pct": 20
    },
    "eval_check": {
      "eval_set": "eval/smoke_v3",
      "regression_delta_threshold": 0.02
    }
  },
  "audit_tag": "canary-2712349999",
  "kill_switch": "ff.model.v13.canary.pause"
}
```
Alex: Important: start with 1-hr dry-run (mirror only) in EU with no user-visible output. After dry-run, if metrics good, flip to live 1% for 30m then ramp.
Marisol: Can we add a human-in-the-loop pause between 1% -> 2%? I want a manual approval step after the first 30m live check.
Priya: Agree — add a manual gate: `manual_approval_after_first_window` -> notify @oncall + @product when triggered.
Jamal: I'll add the automation + playbook link in the PR and wire the slack webhook. Also will add the immediate rollback action to the rollout-service.
Leo: Ping me for review on that PR. I'll add the audit log tag `canary=2712349999` and ensure we emit `rollout_event` entries for every change.
Alex: Can someone add the ops playbook snippet for oncall response (thresholds, contacts, runbook link)? If not, I'll post it later today.
Marisol: I'll draft the playbook and attach to the rollout PR. Also +1 on the manual pause.
Priya: One more ask: ensure we run the regression eval with a stable seed and include sample diff outputs in the CI artifact for inspection.
Alex: Perfect. If no objections, I'll schedule this for 09:00 UTC tomorrow and post the rollout doc link here when scheduled.
Marisol: :thumbsup:
